_comment: Sidecar for ecosystem-scan target ranking. First matching rule wins; match is a case-insensitive substring test against the package name. Compiled from the 2026-09-05 bug bounty research pass (~/.thynkq/runs/perfect-edge-2026-09-05/income/bug-bounty-map.md). Nothing here is a claim about mcp-scan's own findings, only about whether a vendor pays for reports against that package.
